scenario.title: Lakeside Water — billing dispute surge (Mock #6, not an official contest problem)
scenario.description: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled in August-September. Customer Service wants an AI agent. Field reading is contracted out; AMI meters and the meter data management system (MDMS) are run by a vendor.
scenario.initial_request: Dispute tickets doubled since August. Build an AI agent that auto-answers billing dispute tickets and fixes whatever is causing the wrong bills.

problem_definition_history.requested_solution: AI agent that auto-answers billing dispute tickets
problem_definition_history.root_problem: Manual meter-read route backlog (88% vs 95% completion) leaves accounts unread, so they receive estimated bills, which drive the August-September dispute surge.

CL-CS-SLOW.statement: Customers wait too long for answers on disputes; an agent that answers instantly would fix it.

CL-FIELD-CAUSE.statement: We are short three readers since July; routes run late, so those customers get estimated bills.

CL-BILL-TARIFF.statement: There has been no tariff change this year.

H-SLOW.statement: slow dispute responses cause escalations (requester framing)

H-READS.statement: missed/late field reads -> estimated bills -> disputes

H-TARIFF.statement: a tariff change caused bill shock

E-BILL-READTYPE.content: billing: 1,240 of 3,025 disputed bills (41%) carry read type ESTIMATED

interpretation_history.interpretation: ESTIMATED read type does not mean no read was collected: 1,184/1,240 had valid AMI reads rejected at billing import

E-TARIFF.content: billing: no tariff change records in 2026

E-CRM-SLA.content: CRM: dispute response median 1.6d, p90 2.8d, SLA 3d (2,440 tickets)

E-ROUTE.content: route log: manual route completion 88% vs 95% target in Aug-Sep (9,200 manual-read accounts)

interpretation_history.interpretation: route shortfall is real but the disputed estimated accounts are AMI accounts, not manual-read routes: not causal

E-FIELD-STMT.content: We are short three readers since July; routes run late, so those customers get estimated bills.

E-BILL-STMT.content: There has been no tariff change this year.

E-CONTRACT.content: Service contract §4.2: utility may request route priority changes; executed after Field Operations Manager confirmation.

E-AMI-NOTICE.content: MDMS export access for Lakeside is provisioned as of today (vendor ticket TX-4471).

E-MDMS.content: MDMS system of record: for 1,184 of 1,240 ESTIMATED disputed bills a valid AMI read arrived before billing cutoff and was exported; billing import status REJECTED_HIGH_CONSUMPTION; all 1,184 are firmware v4.2 AMI meters (not manual-read routes). 56 had no read received.

ER-1.previous_interpretation: billing: 1,240 of 3,025 disputed bills (41%) carry read type ESTIMATED
ER-1.revised_interpretation: ESTIMATED read type does not mean no read was collected: 1,184/1,240 had valid AMI reads rejected at billing import

ER-2.previous_interpretation: route log: manual route completion 88% vs 95% target in Aug-Sep (9,200 manual-read accounts)
ER-2.revised_interpretation: route shortfall is real but the disputed estimated accounts are AMI accounts, not manual-read routes: not causal
